nodes.title: Reading a call's run-manifest components one-to-one as stack parts
nodes.tried: web data.ts mapped manifest {stt, llm, tts ?? voice, s2s} straight onto {ears, brain, voice, s2s} and resolved it with stackOf.
nodes.broke: The manifest's `voice` is the voice's name (Kore, hi-IN-Kavya), not a part, and `stt` ends in '/ungated' when the ears ran ungated. On the real runtime, a built speech-to-speech stack and ungated ears both showed 'A stack that is no longer listed' on the call page (2 of 3 manifest shapes unresolved). Devsim named an s2s run as 'llm', so the browser flows could not see it.
nodes.instead: web/src/catalog.ts partsRan() maps the manifest to parts (s2s alone, or ears without the suffix + brain + tts). Devsim names an s2s run as the real runtime does. A unit test in tests/web.test.ts covers the three shapes and fails on the old mapping (95f1799).
